maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is specialty commercial property and casualty insurance premiums, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums come mainly from private businesses buying specialty commercial coverages; the Public Sector division is a small part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic underwriting and its own start-up divisions, with only occasional acquisitions and several disposals.

mission_critical.reason: Commercial insurance policies renew annually and are placed through brokers, so businesses can change insurers fairly easily.
